provenance.architecture: async: 202 after private commit, anchor delivered by the outbox relay; tx hashes collected from /anchor_status, not from the ingest response

note: Verified via REAL Ethereum tx hashes returned by the live orchestrator over 71 requests. Duplicates (sequential and concurrent) collapse to exactly one on-chain anchor via the content-hash idempotency slot; distinct requests each get a unique anchor. Orchestrator crash-recovery is a separate test requiring process-kill mid-commit and is noted as future hardening, not claimed here.
